issue.title: REST Client does not encode multi character code points correctly
issue.body: If you attempt to encode a string that contains code points that don't fit into a single char (e.g. emojis) RESTEasy will fail to encode it correctly.

body: Stuart has narrowed this down to a specific bug in RestEasy. It's being tracked in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/10245. Closing this issue in favour of that other one.
I prefer we keep it open so that we are aware of it.

How to send an URI query param decoded? I would like to send "GET /server/api/v1/mail=person@gmail.com" instead of sending "GET /server/api/v1/mail=person%40gmail.com"

I'm using rest client to consumes external API.
